notes: Unresolvable district scopes (no queryable official boundary): PUDDST. Contests/measures scoped to them are hidden rather than shown to the wrong voters.

measures.title: Impose a Sales and Use Tax of One-Tenth of One Percent for the Purpose of Funding Criminal Justice Services
measures.what_it_does: Imposes a 0.1% city sales and use tax (RCW 82.14.450) dedicated to public safety and criminal justice services in Liberty Lake.
measures.cost_line: 0.1% sales and use tax (10 cents on a $100 purchase), projected at about $750,000 a year.

measures.title: Property Tax Levy for Fire Protection
measures.what_it_does: Replaces an expiring one-year excess property tax levy that pays for the town's fire protection services in 2027.
measures.cost_line: About $0.51 per $1,000 of assessed value in 2027, raising $40,934.57.

measures.title: Fire Protection Service Excess Levy
measures.what_it_does: Authorizes a one-year excess property tax levy to pay for the town's fire protection services in 2027.
measures.cost_line: About $1.40 per $1,000 of assessed value in 2027, raising $49,000.

measures.title: Police Protection Service Excess Levy
measures.what_it_does: Authorizes a one-year excess property tax levy to pay for the town's police protection services in 2027.
measures.cost_line: About $1.19 per $1,000 of assessed value in 2027, raising $28,000.

measures.title: Replacement of Expiring Educational Programs and Operations Levy
measures.what_it_does: Replaces an expiring educational programs and operations levy for expenses the state does not fund, including staff compensation, nurses, counselors, safety staff, music, athletics and advanced courses.

measures.title: Replacement Educational Programs and Operation Levy
measures.what_it_does: Replaces an expiring educational programs and operation levy for expenses the state does not fund, including school safety, athletics, art, music, special education and staffing above the state allocation.

measures.title: Replacement Capital Levy for Technology, Security and Infrastructure Improvements
measures.what_it_does: Replaces an expiring capital levy for instructional technology, security cameras and entry controls, and other safety infrastructure.

measures.title: Replacement Capital Levy for Safety, Security, Infrastructure, and Technology Improvements
measures.what_it_does: Replaces an expiring capital levy for safety, security, parking and traffic improvements, plumbing, HVAC, roof and electrical replacement, and educational technology and cybersecurity.

measures.jurisdiction: Nine Mile Falls School District No. 325-179
measures.title: Replacement Educational Programs And Operations Levy
measures.what_it_does: Replaces an expiring educational programs and operations levy for expenses the state does not fund, including safety, music, arts, nurses, counselors, class size reduction, athletics, transportation and technology.

measures.jurisdiction: Nine Mile Falls School District No. 325-179
measures.title: Capital Levy for Safety, Security, and Infrastructure Improvements
measures.what_it_does: A new six-year capital levy to replace a failing roof and condemned portable classrooms at Lakeside High School and modernize security, fire systems, facilities and infrastructure district-wide.
measures.cost_line: Estimated $0.38 per $1,000 of assessed value each year 2027-2032, from $774,853 (2027) to $842,954 (2032).

measures.title: Replacement of Expiring Educational Programs and Operations Levy
measures.what_it_does: Replaces an expiring educational programs and operations levy for programs, services and staff the state does not fund, including electives, vocational education, nurses, counselors, safety, performing arts and athletics.

measures.title: Replacement of Expiring Educational Programs and Operation Levy
measures.what_it_does: Replaces Spokane Public Schools' expiring educational programs and operation levy for expenses the state does not fund, including class size, special education, nurses, counselors, safety staff, music and athletics.

measures.title: Educational Programs and Operations Replacement Levy
measures.what_it_does: Replaces an expiring educational programs and operations levy for expenses the state does not fund, including smaller classes, advanced courses, nurses, counselors, technology, safety, music, athletics and facility maintenance.

measures.title: Safety, Security and Infrastructure Improvements Replacement Levy
measures.what_it_does: Replaces an expiring capital levy for entrance security, door locks and cameras, HVAC replacement at Spokane Valley High and a library addition at Pasadena Park Elementary.

measures.jurisdiction: Spokane County Fire Protection District No. 2
measures.title: Proposition Reauthorizing and Continuing Regular Emergency Medical Services Property Tax Levy
measures.what_it_does: Renews the district's regular emergency medical services property tax levy for six years.
measures.cost_line: $0.50 per $1,000 of assessed value a year for six years, collected beginning in 2027.

measures.jurisdiction: Spokane County Fire Protection District No. 3
measures.title: Emergency Medical Services Property Tax Levy
measures.what_it_does: Authorizes a regular emergency medical services property tax levy for six years.
measures.cost_line: Up to $0.50 per $1,000 of assessed value a year for six years, collected beginning in 2027.

measures.jurisdiction: Spokane County Fire Protection District No. 9
measures.title: Property Tax Levy for Fire Protection and Emergency Services
measures.what_it_does: Restores (lifts) the district's regular property tax levy to $1.50 per $1,000 and allows levy revenue to grow up to 6% a year for five years, the final amount becoming the base for later limits.
measures.cost_line: Levy rate restored to $1.50 per $1,000 of assessed value, with up to 6% annual revenue growth for the next five years.

measures.jurisdiction: Spokane County Fire Protection District No. 9
measures.title: Fire Station and Firefighter Safety Improvements General Obligation Bonds - $70,000,000
measures.what_it_does: Authorizes $70,000,000 in general obligation bonds to renovate, modernize, construct and replace fire stations and build a training building, repaid by excess property taxes.
measures.cost_line: $70,000,000 in bonds maturing within 20 years, repaid by annual excess property taxes (no rate is stated in the ballot title).

measures.jurisdiction: Spokane County Fire Protection District No. 11
measures.title: Emergency Medical Services Property Tax Levy
measures.what_it_does: Authorizes a regular emergency medical services property tax levy for six years.
measures.cost_line: $0.35 per $1,000 of assessed value a year for six years, collected beginning in 2027.

measures.jurisdiction: Spokane County Fire Protection District No. 12
measures.title: Emergency Medical Services Regular Property Tax Levy
measures.what_it_does: Authorizes a regular emergency medical services property tax levy for six years.
measures.cost_line: $0.50 per $1,000 of assessed value a year for six years, collected 2027 through 2032.
